variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: A strike has collapsed in {colony}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The colony has seen a strike collapse. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
